Who We Are About Us Discovering outstanding musical talent and connecting them with world-class opportunities.
Our Vision The Washington Rachmaninoff Musicians Association was founded to discover outstanding musical talent and connect them with world-class opportunities.
As a nonprofit, non-charitable organization, we champion professionalism, discipline, and mentorship in shaping the next generation of classical musicians.
We believe music is both an art and a craft — one that requires passion, precision, and purpose.
WIRMC Competition Host the Washington International Rachmaninoff Music Competition — bringing together outstanding young performers on an international stage.
Education & Training Provide masterclasses, workshops, and performance programs to develop the next generation of classical musicians.
Global Connections Build bridges across the international music community, connecting talent with mentors and performance opportunities worldwide.
Meet the Team The Founding Team Tian Gang Co-Founder · Executive Director
Leads the strategic development and operational execution of the association. With extensive experience in music event management and arts education, he oversees the organization's major initiatives and partnerships.
Haoran Su Co-Founder · North America Coordinator
Coordinates the association's activities across North America — event and venue logistics, volunteer recruitment and management, and on-site operations for WIRMC finals. Serves as the primary point of contact for participating families and partner institutions in the region.
Elena K. Co-Founder · Artistic & Jury Liaison
Works with the international jury panel on adjudication logistics, repertoire review, and artistic standards, ensuring every division is evaluated with professionalism and consistency.
David L. Co-Founder · Education Programs Manager
Designs and organizes masterclasses, workshops, and the summer camp program, connecting young musicians with mentors and structured opportunities to grow between competition seasons.
Grace W. Co-Founder · Communications & Outreach Coordinator
Manages the association's communications — announcements, the annual highlights archive, and outreach to schools, studios, and partner organizations worldwide.

Our Flagship Event WIRMC The Washington International Rachmaninoff Music Competition — a launching platform for the next generation of pianists.
Visit WIRMC Official Site
About the Competition WIRMC is our flagship event — an annual piano competition that brings together gifted pianists from around the world. Inspired by the legacy of Sergei Rachmaninoff, the competition celebrates expressive depth, technical mastery, and bold interpretation.
Each year, we welcome a diverse panel of internationally acclaimed judges and offer participants:
Solo performance opportunities at prestigious venues Professional feedback and mentorship Access to a global community of peers and mentors Junior Division For young emerging talents beginning their journey in classical piano performance.
Youth Division Challenging repertoire for developing pianists ready to demonstrate their growing artistry.
Young Artist Division An advanced platform for pianists approaching professional-level performance.
Professional Division The highest tier — showcasing world-class technique, interpretation, and stage presence.
Recent Global Finals Each year the competition culminates in a Global Final, bringing together outstanding young performers from across the globe.

Annual Highlights · 2025 2025 Global Grand Final Held in New York City, USA
July in New York shone brightly with the sound of music. The 2025 Washington International Rachmaninoff Music Competition (WIRMC) Global Grand Final was held successfully in the world’s music capital, bringing together outstanding young performers from across the globe. On an international stage, under the guidance of world-class juries, these talented musicians showcased their brilliance, artistry, and dedication.
Photo Gallery Competition Moment Featured Performance Musical Collaboration Opening Ceremony Performance Showcase Organizing Team Recognition A world-class event of this scale is only possible through exceptional leadership and teamwork.
